english.notes:
(i) This document applies to offences committed before the 26th June 2022 due to changes made by section 86 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022, which increased the penalty of this offence on indictment from 14 years imprisonment to life imprisonment. For offences before the 27th February 2004, see H3250. For the offence applying from the 27th June 2022, see H100710.
(ii) For the purposes of section 3A, a person is taken to be unfit to drive at any time when his/her ability to drive properly is impaired.
(iii) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(iv) See also offence wording: H3251.
(v) The penalty on indictment for this offence was raised by section 285(4) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 from ten to fourteen years with effect from 27/02/04
(vi) Officers should ensure that they know the CPS Guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges.
